description: Shared PAL closing lines for the typed-input framing overlay. Not story-specific.

lines.text: There's a story that meets you right there.
Let's walk into a moment that feels close to this.
I think there's a story you'll connect with.
There's something in Scripture that understands that.
Let's move into a story that carries something similar.
I want to share something that sits in that same place.
There's a story that holds that kind of weight.
Let's step into a moment that reflects what you're carrying.
There's a story I think will meet you in this.
Let's go somewhere that touches that part of things.
I have a story that carries something close to that.
There's a moment in Scripture that knows that feeling.
